facts.label: Since e for
facts.sub: Since + ponto: since 2008. For + período: for ten years. Pergunte How long have you…? Use o present perfect.

facts.label: Desde
facts.sub: Use since com um ponto no tempo: since 2008, since Monday, since school. Ele diz quando algo começou. Use o present perfect: I have known her since school. Em português, é “desde”.

facts.label: Há / por
facts.sub: Use for com um período de tempo: for ten years, for two weeks, for a long time. Em português, muitas vezes é “há”: We have been friends for ten years.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Since is used with a point in time.
For is used with a point in time.
items.why: For goes with a period: for two years.

items.s: “I have known her for 2008” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Since is used with a point in time. → Verdadeiro (Yes: since Monday.)
For is used with a point in time. → Falso (For goes with a period: for two years.)
“I have known her for 2008” is correct. → Falso (Say since 2008.)

pages.title: Old friends in Boston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Friday afternoon in Boston. Lena and Clara sit in a small cafe near the river. Clara shows Lena a photo on her phone. It is her old friend Julia, from school. Lena is new in the city and has few friends. She wants to hear how a long friendship works.

“How long have you known your friend Julia, Clara?” says Lena. “I have known her since school. We were classmates in 2008.” says Clara. “Wow! You have been friends for more than fifteen years.” says Lena.
